title: Exhibition loan conditions
bodyMd:
### Loan offers
Three lenders offer objects for a six-day exhibition. The Crystal lender requires a temperature logger throughout every exhibition day. The Copper lender requires two guards present whenever its object is displayed. The Textile lender forbids display on the final two days.

### Staffing and equipment plan
One guard is available on each of days1–6. A second guard is available on days2,3,5 only. A temperature logger is available on days1–4 only. The gallery has room for all three objects simultaneously.

### Curator’s instruction
Each selected object must be displayed on at least three exhibition days, not necessarily consecutive. An object may be stored on other days, but every lender condition still applies as written. Equipment and staffing cannot be increased.
